import zipfile, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
      'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Files in archive:")
for n in z.namelist():
    print(" ", n)

wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
sheets = [(s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
          for s in wb.find('m:sheets', NS)]
print("\nSheets:", sheets)

rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rid2target = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}

shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    sst = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in sst.findall('m:si', NS):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))

for name, rid in sheets:
    target = rid2target[rid]
    if not target.startswith('xl/'):
        target = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ({target}) ===")
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
    sd = root.find('m:sheetData', NS)
    for row in sd.findall('m:row', NS):
        cells = []
        for c in row.findall('m:c', NS):
            ref = c.get('r')
            t = c.get('t')
            v = c.find('m:v', NS)
            val = v.text if v is not None else None
            if t == 's' and val is not None:
                val = shared[int(val)]
            elif t == 'inlineStr':
                is_ = c.find('m:is', NS)
                val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')) if is_ is not None else None
            elif t == 'b':
                val = val == '1'
            cells.append(f"{ref}={val!r}")
        print(f"row {row.get('r')}: " + " | ".join(cells))

import pandas as pd

xls = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
grand_total = 0.0
for s in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name=s, header=None)
    print(f"\n=== Sheet: {s} (shape {df.shape}) ===")
    print(df.to_string(max_rows=80, max_cols=25))
    numeric = df.select_dtypes(include='number')
    sheet_total = numeric.values.sum()
    grand_total += sheet_total
    print(f"Sum of all numeric cells in '{s}': {sheet_total}")
print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL (all numeric cells across all sheets): {grand_total}")

import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
RNS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'

def q(tag):
    return f'{{{NS}}}{tag}'

def col_idx(ref):
    m = re.match(r'([A-Za-z]+)', ref)
    n = 0
    for ch in m.group(1):
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch.upper()) - 64)
    return n - 1

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("Files in archive:", names)

    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall(q('si')):
            shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(q('t'))))

    wbroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    relmap = {rel.get('Id'): rel.get('Target') for rel in rels}

    grand_total = 0.0
    for sh in wbroot.iter(q('sheet')):
        name = sh.get('name')
        rid = sh.get(f'{{{RNS}}}id')
        target = relmap.get(rid, '')
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
        sheetroot = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))

        rows = {}
        maxr = maxc = 0
        for row in sheetroot.iter(q('row')):
            r = int(row.get('r')) - 1
            for c in row.findall(q('c')):
                ci = col_idx(c.get('r'))
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find(q('v'))
                isel = c.find(q('is'))
                val = None
                if t == 's' and v is not None:
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t == 'inlineStr' and isel is not None:
                    val = ''.join(tt.text or '' for tt in isel.iter(q('t')))
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                rows[(r, ci)] = val
                maxr = max(maxr, r)
                maxc = max(maxc, ci)

        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ===")
        for r in range(maxr + 1):
            line = []
            for ci in range(maxc + 1):
                v = rows.get((r, ci), '')
                line.append(str(v) if v is not None else '')
            print(f"r{r+1}: " + " | ".join(line))

        total = 0.0
        for (r, ci), val in rows.items():
            if val is not None:
                try:
                    total += float(val)
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    pass
        print(f"Numeric sum in '{name}': {total}")
        grand_total += total

    print(f"\nGRAND TOTAL numeric sum across all sheets: {grand_total}")
